Specification: cbc_max: A two-phase Byzantine-fault-tolerant consensus protocol for N processes with at most F crash failures and T Byzantine faults (assumption: 2 *T < N). Each process maintains a matrix V of received values per sender. Actions: Crash, Receive (updates V[i][j] based on phase/message type via IF-THEN-ELSE), BcastPhs1, Phs1 (awaits N-T Phs1 messages, sets w = MAX(V[i])), BcastPhs2, Phs2 (decides on threshold majority or moves to CHOOSE state), Choose (picks any value seen in V[i] via CHOOSE). Properties: TypeOK, Validity, Agreement, Termination, Condition1, RealTermination.
